mapper.sql: F.FILE_SN AS fileSn, F.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, F.FILE_SE_CD AS fileSeCd, F.TOC_SN AS tocSn, F.INTG_CYCL AS intgCycl, F.VER_NO AS verNo, F.LAST_YN AS lastYn, F.DCSMKR_ID AS dcsmkrId, D.USER_NM AS dcsmkrNm, F.CFMTN_DT AS cfmtnDt, F.ORGNL_FILE_NM AS orgnlFileNm, F.STRG_FILE_NM AS strgFileNm, F.FILE_PATH_NM AS filePathNm, F.FILE_SZ AS fileSz, F.FILE_EXTN_NM AS fileExtnNm, F.MEMO_CN AS memoCn, F.RGTR_ID AS rgtrId, U.USER_NM AS rgtrNm, F.REG_DT AS regDt, F.DEL_YN AS delYn, F.DLTR_ID AS dltrId, X.USER_NM AS dltrNm, F.DEL_DT AS delDt, F.DEL_RSN AS delRsn, CASE WHEN F.FILE_SE_CD = 'FL030' THEN F.INTG_CYCL || '차 통합본' ELSE TRIM(T.TOC_NO || ' ' || T.TOC_NM) END AS targetNm
FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = F.RGTR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER D ON D.USER_ID = F.DCSMKR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER X ON X.USER_ID = F.DLTR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TOC T ON T.TOC_SN = F.TOC_SN
mapper.select: SELECT PBANC_STTS_CD FROM TB_BID_PBANC WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}
SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM TB_ATCH_FILE WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND FILE_SE_CD = #{fileSeCd} AND TOC_SN = #{tocSn}
SELECT NVL(MAX(INTG_CYCL), 0) + 1 FROM TB_ATCH_FILE WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND FILE_SE_CD = 'FL030'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ATCH_FILE (PBANC_SN, FILE_SE_CD, TOC_SN, INTG_CYCL, VER_NO, LAST_YN, ORGNL_FILE_NM, STRG_FILE_NM, FILE_PATH_NM, FILE_SZ, FILE_EXTN_NM, MEMO_CN, RGTR_ID) VALUES (#{pbancSn}, #{fileSeCd}, #{tocSn, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{intgCycl, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{verNo}, 'N', #{orgnlFileNm}, #{strgFileNm}, #{filePathNm}, #{fileSz}, #{fileExtnNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{memoCn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{rgtrId})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ATCH_FILE SET LAST_YN = 'N', DCSMKR_ID = NULL, CFMTN_DT = NULL WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND FILE_SE_CD = 'FL030' AND LAST_YN = 'Y'
UPDATE TB_ATCH_FILE SET LAST_YN = 'Y', DCSMKR_ID = #{userId}, CFMTN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE FILE_SN = #{fileSn}
